vote: Votes on a post or comment with a weight from -100% to 100%
comment: Publishes or edits a post, an artwork or a comment
transfer: Sends PIXA or PXS with an optional memo
transfer_to_vesting: Powers up PIXA into Pixa Power, for oneself or another account
withdraw_vesting: Starts, changes or cancels a power-down
limit_order_create: Places an order on the internal PIXA/PXS market
feed_publish: A witness publishes its PIXA price of one PXS
convert: Converts PXS into PIXA after 3.5 days
account_create: Opens an account for a fee
account_update: Changes keys, the memo key or json_metadata
account_witness_vote: Approves or withdraws approval of a witness
account_witness_proxy: Names an account to vote in one's place
delete_comment: Removes a post or comment that has no replies and no positive votes
custom_json: Carries JSON for applications: follows, reblogs, communities, credit delegation
comment_options: Sets a post's payout options and beneficiaries
set_withdraw_vesting_route: Routes part of a power-down to another account
limit_order_create2: Places an order with an exchange rate
claim_account: Buys an account ticket with the fee or with credits
create_claimed_account: Opens an account with a ticket
change_recovery_account: Names a new recovery partner, effective after 30 days
escrow_transfer: Puts PIXA or PXS in escrow with an agent
transfer_to_savings: Moves PIXA or PXS into savings
decline_voting_rights: Gives up voting for ever, after 30 days
claim_reward_balance: Moves pending rewards into the balances
delegate_vesting_shares: Lends Pixa Power to another account
witness_set_properties: Updates a witness's properties one at a time
account_update2: Changes keys or metadata; the posting level can change posting_json_metadata alone
create_proposal: Proposes a daily payment from the DPF
update_proposal_votes: Approves or withdraws approval of proposals
update_proposal: Lowers a proposal's pay or shortens it
collateralized_convert: Converts PIXA into PXS at once, against collateral
recurrent_transfer: Sets up, changes or cancels a repeating transfer
fill_convert_request: A convert settles, 3.5 days after it was sent
author_reward: A post pays out: the author's PXS, PIXA and Pixa Power
curation_reward: A post pays out: one per curator, in Pixa Power
comment_reward: A post pays out: the totals
interest: Hive pays interest on HBD held in savings; Pixa never does, its rate being fixed at 0
fill_vesting_withdraw: A weekly power-down instalment is paid
fill_order: Two orders match on the internal market
shutdown_witness: An event in witness scheduling, not described here
hardfork: A hardfork applies: block 402,205 for HF29, block 949,330 for HF30
return_vesting_delegation: Removed delegated stake returns to the delegator after 5 days
comment_benefactor_reward: A post pays out: one per beneficiary
clear_null_account_balance: Balances sent to null are burned
proposal_pay: A proposal receives its hourly payment
dhf_funding: Every hour, at maintenance: the treasury's share of issuance accumulated since the last one, in PXS; the per-block share is exact since HF30 (dhf_funding.hpp, dhf_processor.cpp:326-338)
delayed_voting: Powered-up stake matures and gains governance weight, 30 days after the power-up
consolidate_treasury_balance: The treasury's balances are consolidated at maintenance
effective_comment_vote: Every vote: its rshares, weight and the post's totals
ineffective_delete_comment: Never on Pixa: it recorded a delete that could not take effect before Steem's hardfork 19, and since then such a delete is rejected instead (ev_soc:69-76)
dhf_conversion: PIXA the treasury holds or receives is converted to PXS
expired_account_notification: An account's governance votes expire after 365 days without a governance action
changed_recovery_account: A recovery partner change takes effect, 30 days after the request
transfer_to_vesting_completed: A power-up completes, with the VESTS received
fill_collateralized_convert_request: A collateralized_convert settles and returns the excess collateral
system_warning: The chain corrects something and says so: a conversion short of collateral, a median price corrected by the hard limit, and conditions in witness scheduling
failed_recurrent_transfer: A recurring payment fails for lack of funds
limit_order_cancelled: An order is cancelled or expires
producer_missed: A scheduled witness did not produce its block
collateralized_convert_immediate_convers: A collateralized_convert issues PXS at once
escrow_approved: Both parties approved an escrow; the agent is paid
escrow_rejected: An escrow was rejected or its deadline passed
proxy_cleared: A proxy is removed by the chain, at vote expiry or when voting rights are declined
